title: GCC simulation and analysis code
description: Software archive for the Gamma-Code Consensus (GCC) project. Version v1.2.0 adds OpenNeuro ds006623 fMRI validation scripts and derived results, robustness-grid and permutation-control outputs, OpenNeuro ds003367 traumatic coma/DoC HARDI structural backbone analyses, OpenNeuro ds004504 neurodegenerative EEG P1-proxy analyses, updated figures, and the focused NoC-oriented manuscript version including ds006623, ds003367, ds004504, HCP, and EEG validation layers.
